title: Delicious journey in Barcelona
text:
I had an amazing experience on this tapas tour! Our guides was knowledgeable, friendly, and full of passion for Spanish cuisine. We visited several authentic tapas bars, each with its own unique atmosphere and specialty dishes, especially bravas in el sortidor and pintxos😋🔥 

Highly recommend this tour for anyone wanting to explore Barcelona through its food a must do for foodies and first-time visitors alike!
author: validak2021
